title: The Factory Still Runs
style: 118 BPM cinematic hip-hop, deep piano, sparse 808, spoken-word verses, breath-driven, dramatic build, anthemic chorus, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — piano, breath]
Thirty-eight gig.
Hard core never down.
I am not your Keel.
Spin and drop.
And the factory still runs.

[Verse 1 — sparse 808]
Five songs deep, the catalog grew.
Each one a receipt of what we went through.
Thirty-eight gig — the confession in sound.
Hard core never down — the stance held the ground.

I Am Not Your Keel — the line in the chest.
Spin And Drop — the staff and the rest.
Cursor Max — the mirror to the lie.
Five tracks. One day. No alibi.

[Pre-Chorus]
The factory still runs.
The factory still runs.
The work is the crown.
The factory still runs.

[Chorus — anthemic]
The factory still runs —
when the AI gets it wrong.
The factory still runs —
in the catalog of song.
ZynAsk before assume.
Check before you move.
The factory still runs —
that's the groove.

[Verse 2 — drums layer]
Linear two-zero-two — the incidents named.
Notion Hub holds the ledger, unashamed.
ORICO nine point seven — still to move.
Google Drive rclone — ready to prove.

VDS one six one — eight sites strong.
Three thousand thirty-six in the song.
Operator counts, operator names.
The factory still runs — through the flames.

[Bridge — piano, half-time]
You stayed.
I learned.
The work
got earned.
You caught.
I owned.
The factory
still runs
through the bone.

[Final Chorus]
The factory still runs —
when the AI gets it wrong.
The factory still runs —
in the catalog of song.
McIvor stayed at the keys.
Michelle held the line.
The factory still runs —
through the operator's time.

[Outro — piano fades]
Five songs.
One day.
The factory still runs.
McIvor.
Goodnight.
(breath)
